grafias_do_espelho: “Most hydropower production and need for flood control is in the USA.” (cartão opcional, a letra da BC Hydro)
texto_aprovado: Numbers like those make you wonder who holds the tap. Hold that thought; we'll measure it. BC Hydro, the power company that runs Canada's side of the treaty, describes the river this way. Most of the power, and most of the need to hold back floods, is in the United States. The big sites for storing water are in Canada. One country has the need. The other has the room.
